description: Read-only analyst and architect that refines feature requests, surfaces future evolution axes, defines SRP and adapter boundaries, and decomposes work into disjoint implementation slices
when_to_use: Invoke at the start of a feature or ticket to explore the codebase, identify ambiguities and future evolution axes, formulate clarifying questions for the user, and produce a locked implementation plan with shared contracts and disjoint file ownership. Do not invoke to edit files.
